lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters distributed with regular spacing across the visible posterior-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (~20-40 pixels in width) intersecting horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal linear features along the upper flank/dorsal region, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition (bright superior edge to dark inferior shadow).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs observed within the bounds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily along the posterior edge.
